name: WhautoChat
description: WhautoChat is an omnichannel automation platform for WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram, and web live chat. It unifies a shared team inbox, AI chatbots trained on your business data, no-code automation workflows, broadcast and segmentation, contact and lead management, CSAT and analytics, plus API and webhooks. Offered as Cloud SaaS or self-hosted with optional white-label editions.
